Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and limited
range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the clinical picture seen in this type of crash. Over the
course of tewlve visits, the patient received a structured program of manual therapy, targeted stretching, and a home exercise
plan, which followed a typical course for a cervical strain. Treatment intensity was reduced gradually as symptoms improved and
range of motion returned toward baseline. On examination, paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical rotation were
documented and support the reported injury, while neurological screening, reflex testing, and motor strength were within normal
limits. The patient reports a prior mild strain to the same region several years ago, which resolved completely without lasting
limitation. Billing records show two similar charges entered on the same day, which are currently under review for accuracy.
Overall prognosis is good, with expected full recovery and discharge from active care.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
